name: The Route Board
surface: Dispatcher Management Console and Owner Portal

scope.excludeReason: The navigation rails are excluded by instruction; the dispatcher rail's alignment contract is recorded at AGENT_HANDSHAKE.md:43-47 and every measurement in it is load-bearing. src/components/ui/dialog.tsx is now in scope: its backdrop-blur-xs scrim was removed this round and verified against a dispatcher modal. src/app/routes.tsx carries three temporary unprotected verification routes (/__owner, /__dispatch, /__places) which are removed before commit and are not part of the system.

type.monoJob: data and measurement only: money, quantities, timers, route numbers

roles.use: money, quantities, timers, route numbers; tabular
surface and panel titles, route-plate destinations

ink.note: tinted with the field's hue, never dead grey; deliberately no third level

signal.meaning: you must act; the primary action and the states that demand a decision, and nothing else

rejected.reason: 4.23:1 under white text fails AA at 17px/700; 3.89:1 on navy

status.law: one fill and one ink per meaning; a status may never be carried by colour alone

waiting.means: someone else owes the next move

rules.invariant: a surface's boundary is always heavier than any rule inside it

motion.appliedTo: anything declaring a transition inside the surface

browserSurfaces.layering: deliberately unlayered so it outranks Tailwind utilities; the ground and ink declarations sit in @layer base so components can override them
browserSurfaces.layeringRule: anything a component may need to override goes in @layer base; anything meant to outrank utilities stays unlayered, with a comment
browserSurfaces.scope: keyed on bare [data-surface] so one rule set serves both skins; every colour in it is a token, and each skin redefines those tokens on its own root. Formerly dispatch.css, scoped to [data-surface="dispatch"], where six of the seven rule groups reached only the portalled overlays because the console root carried data-portal and never data-surface.

requiredAttributes.data-surface: one of "dispatch" or "owner", on the surface root AND on any portalled content (dialogs, modals, overlays), which renders at document.body outside it. The value also selects the skin.
requiredAttributes.data-on-field: any subtree painted on the navy field; inverts the focus ring and selection
requiredAttributes.data-portal: the portal shell; carries the icon stroke only
requiredAttributes.data-figure: every numeric span; gets tabular numerals and the correct letterforms
requiredAttributes.data-elevate: Owner skin only: opts one element back into the single shadow step

tailwindMerge.rule: every new named text-*, shadow-* or rounded-* role must be declared here
failureModes: an undeclared text-* role is read as a colour, conflicts with a real colour, and is silently dropped
an undeclared shadow-* or rounded-* role does not conflict, so both classes reach the DOM and stylesheet order decides
tailwindMerge.detectability: invisible to tsc, vite build and the design detector; only visible in the live element's classList and computed value

PanelShell.contract: three pinned zones and exactly one scroller; owns all viewport math
PanelShell.header: board caps title plus an optional figure on the field
PanelShell.figureUrgent: spends the signal red; only where the count means someone must act

PanelState.contract: { isLoading, error, errorBody, isEmpty, hasFilters, onRetry, onResetFilters }
PanelState.invariant: error is ordered before isEmpty, so no code path renders a failure as reassurance
PanelState.loading: skeleton rows shaped like the content, not a centred spinner
PanelState.alignment: top-aligned under the controls, not centred in the scroller
PanelState.errorBody: optional override for the failure sentence, added so a caller cannot accidentally print the same sentence twice

Field.contract: render prop receiving { id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid } from useId
Field.invariant: cannot be rendered without wiring the label

DispatcherCard.Region: replaces nested cards: ground change plus macro gap, no second box
DispatcherCard.Label: micro uppercase label plus a hairline to the column edge
DispatcherCard.Header: title left, status right, hairline beneath; no eyebrow, ever

DispatcherButton.iconOnly: aria-label required at the type level

DispatcherBadge.note: the only correct way to render an errand status, in either skin

DispatcherInlineBanner.note: the replacement for alert(); both pairings above 4.5:1

DispatcherSearchField.note: aria-label required at the type level

primitives.barrel: index.ts re-exports portal-neutral aliases (PanelCard, PanelButton, StatusChip, InlineBanner, SearchField) alongside PanelShell, PanelState, Field and ConfirmDialog. New code in either portal imports from there; five files still carry Dispatcher* declared names, which is historical rather than meaningful.

portalRoot.reason: min-h-screen is a floor, so content scrolled the page and took the pinned header with it

masterDetail.required: min-w-0 and min-h-0 on both tracks

layout.belowLg: a THE BOARD / THE RUN toggle, one pane at a time; never a vertical stack with fixed minimum heights
layout.overflowCheck: per element (scrollWidth vs its own clientWidth); the page-level check is vacuous under overflow-hidden

principles: a failed fetch is not an empty result
null from an apiService call means the request failed, never that there is nothing to report
a figure nobody received shows as --, not 0, and the band and the strip must agree
never invent a number, a name or a status
rows must add up to the total above them; label an estimate as an estimate
optimistic writes must be revertible, awaited, and must not clear a composer or close a screen until they succeed

drafts.clear: blanks the box; only for text that has been sent
drafts.forgetDrafts: drops drafts and leaves the fields alone; for a saved form
drafts.seed: fills from a fetch only when nothing is half-typed, and never writes to the store

copy.errors: say what failed and what to do, in the product's own words

verification.contrastPairsMeasured: 22 for the dispatch skin, 20 for the owner skin, 0 failures
limits: the API is unreachable from the development machine (CORS against api.sugo-express.org; the local server answers 401 with stale seed credentials), so no state in either skin has been verified against production records
all fourteen screenshots in .impeccable/review/ for the Owner Portal are failure or empty states; populated density, table rules and the period-change beat are unverified by any capture
the order-chat overlay's five stage cards, payment ledger and conversation pane are verified by typecheck and build only
Chrome's headless window clamps to a 500px minimum on this machine, so the 390px case is measured numerically rather than photographed

followUps: route each panel's primary list through the errand-plate treatment, which the finish review asked for and neither round has done

owner.character: cool slate ground, a ledger rather than a dashboard
owner.overrides: eight colour values and one elevation rule; nothing else
owner.mechanism: every token utility compiles to a var() reference, @theme emits its variables into a plain :root,:host rule, and custom properties resolve per element, so a descendant carrying data-surface="owner" that redefines a property overrides it for its whole subtree. :root,:host can never match a div inside <body>, so specificity never arbitrates and no cascade layer is involved. Zero edits to the 51 already-reviewed Dispatcher files.
inherited: the seven type roles and the 12px floor
the five status tones and the status law
the signal red (the portal's own red-600 is already #DC2626)
the honesty layer and the copy rules

field.trimNote: NOT slate-400. #94A3B8 on #1E3A5F measures 4.49:1 and fails AA for normal text by one hundredth, and PanelShell sets its figure label in text-board-trim at 12px. #98A7BB measures 4.70:1 as text on the field and 2.23:1 as a scrollbar thumb on the ground, where the floor is 3:1 for component identification rather than 4.5:1 for text.

ground.note: slate-100, not the slate-50 the portal shipped: with no shadows, a white plate on #F8FAFC is a 1.5% luminance step and effectively invisible.

ink.note: 16.3:1 and 6.9:1 on the ground. Deliberately no third level: the portal shipped text-slate-400 on light grounds 142 times at 2.83:1, and a third lighter level is how 2.83:1 returns.

rules.invariant: a plate's own boundary is always heavier than any rule inside it; a plate's edge is structural and stays, a hairline ring added for looks does not

elevation.basis: AGENT_HANDSHAKE.md [LOCKED] Flat Design Surface Purity and Zero-Shadow
elevation.mechanism: shadow-plate does NOT compile to var(--shadow-plate); Tailwind emits --tw-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 var(--tw-shadow-color, #0f20350f), resolving the colour at build time. The skin cannot retire it by redefining a token, so owner.css sets the same variable Tailwind composes from, which is what shadow-none does. Rings and inset rings compose separately, so a focus ring still lands.
elevation.status: GUARD, not a repair: no Owner file imports PanelCard/DispatcherCard today and no Owner screen passes a figure, so neither shadow currently renders here. The rule exists because adopting the shared card primitive is the obvious next refactor, at which point every white plate would quietly acquire a drop shadow with nothing failing.

optIn.where: the notification popover, and two map controls plus the name tag floating over map imagery

contrast.statusFills: roughly 1.2:1 against a plate, and correct: the fill is not the indicator. The status law forbids colour-alone encoding, so every tone pairs with a label and a CSS-drawn mark. Do not darken a fill to 'fix' this.

conventions: every rendered count routes through one unknown-judgement per screen (fig(), countsUnknown, or a guarded helper), so a screen cannot hold two answers to one question; a count nobody received is a dash, never a zero
two glyphs for two absences, each carrying a title saying which: an ellipsis means still arriving, an em dash means never arrived
StandingFigures is the portal's single device for stating a live figure: one navy plate divided by column rules, adopted by the dashboard (3), Tracking (4) and Riders (3)
OwnerPanelShell sets the page h1 once, with no header card and no tinted icon chip; the boundary under the pinned zone is a rule, not a box
OwnerTabs implements the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern with a roving tabindex, no shadow and no rounded-full pill; a two-state toggle uses aria-pressed inside role=group instead
a period change clears its data in the same beat, so no figure is held over from another period under a new heading
notCanonized: 10 of roughly 50 form controls are label-wired, all ten in ServiceRatesModule; aria-describedby and aria-invalid are 0 portal-wide. The shared Field primitive is the destination.
five hand-rolled overlays still lack role=dialog, a focus trap and Escape (MerchantCategoryModule, PlacesTab, AddUserModal, EditUserModal twice) while ConfirmDialog is built and in use
one header TREATMENT on eight screens but one header COMPONENT on five; Users, Merchants and Tracking keep their own header row, giving four mounts of HeaderClock/NotificationBell rather than one

two placeholder spellings coexist: the em dash / ellipsis pair on the dashboard and StandingFigures, and the older -- on Users, Tracking and Places. The two-glyph convention is the rule; the -- sites are unconverted, not a second sanctioned form.
